specs.description: where spec stores a spec: docs/specs files, GitHub issues, or both
specs.label: Plans
specs.about: where I save the plan for a change
specs.question: Where should I save the plan for a change?

issues.label: GitHub issue
issues.gives: an issue on GitHub, no file

both.label: Both
both.gives: a file plus a matching GitHub issue

budget.description: off: no exo dispatch sets a model or effort, so every agent inherits the session. on: a hook sets each dispatch's model and effort from the kind table in lib/model-kinds.json and steps a build-task or doc-task up one level on its retry. The old names fast, balanced, quality, low, lean, medium, normal, high and full still read as on
budget.label: Effort
budget.about: how much care and cost each task gets
budget.question: How much effort should each task get?

on.label: On
on.gives: each task gets a model and effort fitted to its kind, one level up on a retry

ship.description: the finish route ship takes without asking: ask puts the question; pr-merge, open-pr, push or local run that route when it can
ship.label: Finished work
ship.about: what happens once work is done
ship.question: What should happen once work is finished?

pr-merge.label: Merge it
pr-merge.gives: a pull request, merged once checks pass

open-pr.label: Open a PR
open-pr.gives: a pull request left open for you

push.label: Push
push.gives: pushed straight up, no pull request

workspace.description: where a code-changing run commits without asking: ask puts the question; branch, worktree or current take that place
workspace.label: Code changes
workspace.question: Where should I put code changes?

branch.label: New branch
branch.gives: a new branch in this folder

worktree.label: Separate folder
worktree.gives: a new branch in its own folder

current.label: Current branch
current.gives: straight onto the branch you are on

receipts.description: whether exo shows the user a one-line receipt when it starts, dispatches a helper or refuses a command: on shows them (they cost the model no tokens); off shows none
receipts.label: Receipts
receipts.about: whether I show a line when exo acts
receipts.question: Should exo show a line when it starts or refuses something?

on.label: Show them
on.gives: one short line each time exo starts, hands work to a helper or refuses a command

off.label: Hide them
off.gives: no such lines; the work and the refusals are the same

memory.description: whether exo keeps a project memory: on lets sessions read it, book lessons and decisions into it; off writes nothing and reads nothing, and the memory file is never deleted
memory.label: Memory
memory.about: whether I keep notes about this project between sessions
memory.question: Should exo keep notes about this project between sessions?

on.label: Keep notes
on.gives: sessions read the project memory and add lessons and decisions to it

off.label: Keep none
off.gives: nothing is read or written; any existing memory file stays as it is

env.description: whether a run copies the local env files of the main checkout into its worktree: ask puts the question; copy copies them; never copies none
env.label: Local env files
env.about: whether runs copy your env files
env.question: Should runs copy your local env files?

copy.label: Copy them
copy.gives: env files are copied into the run folder
